title: Card
description: Generic bordered surface container with the shadcn Card's named parts: CardHeader stacks a CardTitle (react-aria Heading, level picks the element) over a CardDescription, and CardFooter rows up the actions. Promoted out of the summary-card family when the SCOUT report timeline became its second consumer; the parts arrived with the login screen.

anatomy.description: A div with data-slot="card": bark-50 surface, bark-200 hairline border, the house radius. Accepts any div props and a className to extend.
data-slot="card-header": a column with 0.25rem gap for the title and description.
react-aria Heading with data-slot="card-title": display-sm, weight 700, needle-600. `level` picks the element (h2 by default; a card that is the page's main content passes 1).
A p with data-slot="card-description": text-base, bark-600, the muted intro under a title.
data-slot="card-footer": a row of actions with 0.5rem gap; extend it to stack actions.

usage: Compose content inside; Card owns only the surface, border and radius, never padding conventions of its children.
Prefer extending Card over drawing a bordered box in a route or feature module.
A card's title and intro are CardTitle and CardDescription inside CardHeader; never restate their size or colour in route CSS (theming §1.6).
CardContent is deliberately not ported: Card already pads. Put the body straight inside Card between the header and the footer.
Promotion precedent: a private descendant becomes a top-level component like this one when a second, unrelated component needs it.
